name: Dynagreen Environmental Protection Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Dynagreen Environmental Protection Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment, technical consulting, construction, operation, and maintenance of waste incineration power plants in the People's Republic of China. It is involved in waste-to- energy, organic waste disposal, sludge treatment, waste collection and transportation, ECO industrial park, and other businesses. The company also provides comprehensive solutions for urban waste management. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
